sample_tickets.title: Users locked out after credential rotation — Cannot authenticate
sample_tickets.description: All users across our organization were force-logged out and are unable to re-authenticate. JWT errors on API calls. Affects 68 users. This is a blocker for our morning reporting run.
sample_tickets.root_cause: Platform-wide JWT key rotation during security incident (Oct 2024 breach)
sample_tickets.resolution: Customers directed to re-login. New tokens issued. Engineering confirmed new JWT key working.

sample_tickets.title: API v2 migration broke our Salesforce connector — data not syncing
sample_tickets.description: After API v2 went live, our custom Salesforce integration stopped pulling opportunity data. Error: 'field_mapping_deprecated' on /api/v2/integrations/crm. We have 3 CSMs relying on this data daily.
sample_tickets.root_cause: API v2 changed field schema for CRM connector endpoints without backward compatibility. Breaking change not flagged in migration guide.
sample_tickets.resolution: Provided updated field mapping. Offered white-glove migration call. Bug logged as ENG-4421 for API migration guide update.
sample_tickets.follow_up: Account flagged as churn risk. CSM assigned.

sample_tickets.title: Dashboard loading times >30 seconds — unusable
sample_tickets.description: Our analytics dashboard takes 28–45 seconds to load for any date range >30 days. Other customers must be affected too. This is a daily workflow for our ops team.
sample_tickets.root_cause: PostgreSQL query without index on large accounts. Compound query on KPI table scanning 4.8M rows for accounts with >18 months of data.
sample_tickets.resolution: Engineering added composite index (ENG-4389). Immediate improvement from 28s → 1.8s for affected query. Deployed hotfix Dec 4.

sample_tickets.title: Request: Slack integration for anomaly alerts
sample_tickets.description: We have 4 analysts who need real-time Slack notifications when an anomaly is detected. Currently we check the dashboard manually. Competitor X has this. This is a renewal risk for us — our contract is up in April.
sample_tickets.resolution: Feature request logged as PRD-892. PM confirmed Q2 2025 delivery. Account flagged as strategic — CSM to share roadmap preview.
